gaps.sentence: ___ answering my question directly, he changed the subject.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' highlights the action that did not happen.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather cycle ___ wait twenty minutes for an unreliable bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Would rather... than...' is the fixed pattern for preferences.

gaps.sentence: The course offers not only theory ___ hands-on fieldwork.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only... but also' is the fixed correlative pair.

gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.

gaps.sentence: I enjoyed the film; the ending was weak, ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Though' can come at the end of a sentence as a casual contrast marker; the others cannot.

gaps.sentence: The essay was submitted late and, ___, it ignored the brief entirely.
gaps.explanation: 'What is more' adds a further, stronger point to an already negative picture.

gaps.sentence: Take a jumper ___ the evening turns cold.
gaps.explanation: 'In case' = as a precaution against possibility.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.
